about: Check-in chat replies for check-chat-context.mjs (made-up students). Regenerate with --refresh rather than edit.

why matched.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched.reply: The app matched you because you both enjoy live music and gigs, and like watching films in your free time. Your mentor is also the laid-back kind of person you asked for.

how often.reply: You asked to meet every two weeks. You can find your mentor's details on [[Your Mentor]].

checklist.reply:
You have joining a society and finding a dentist left to do on your [[Checklist]]. 
Would you like some ideas for societies that fit your interests?

who is my mentor.reply: You can find your mentor's name and how to get in touch on the [[Your Mentor]] page.

course society.ask: Can you suggest a society for my course?
course society.reply: Since you are studying English literature, you might enjoy the [[English]] society.

why matched, waiting.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, waiting.reply: Your mentoring coordinator is finding you a mentor by hand, so you do not have one matched yet. You can check the [[Find a mentor]] page for updates or to ask for one.

why matched, no mentor.ask: Why did you match me with my mentor?
why matched, no mentor.reply: You haven't been matched with a mentor yet, but you can ask for one on the [[Find a mentor]] page whenever you are ready.
